integrity: Analytic proof plus finite reproducibility checker; numerical tests supplement the proof; historical priority provisional.
scientific_limitations: Local asymptotic stability only; full text beyond the beginning of the motivating article could not be inspected; no global quantitative stability or historical uniqueness is asserted. The global volume maximizer and Hodge-star factorization are prior results.
title: The full volume-Hessian spectrum and sharp local stability of the nine-vertex spherical four-polytope
